text_block_list.text:
One day, there was an unveiling ceremony for
Daiichi Ruby's Racing Outfit, and I attended
as her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lady Guest
text_block_list.text:
It has been a long time, Lady Ruby.
You are looking truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —You have my deepest gratitude.

Inside the venue,
Daiichi Ruby was conversing with the guests.

text_block_list.name: Lady Guest
text_block_list.text:
With such a graceful silhouette,
she's sure to captivate everyone's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Lady Guest
text_block_list.text:
That noble color of yours also reminds me
of how your mother and grandmother looked.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are quite perceptive. The red and yellow
were inherited from my mother's and grandmother's racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: So that I never forget the pride of our clan.

text_block_list.name: Lady Guest
text_block_list.text:
The purple color really stands out, too. Did you
have a specific reason for choosing it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: This was suggested by my parents.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Purple has been a noble color since ancient times.
I was advised that it is fitting for one who seeks the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "And then... they said this color goes very well with my eyes."

Hearing that story, I felt like I understood how her parents felt.
Their reason for recommending purple was—

Purple is a noble, powerful color.
It's a wish of encouragement, hoping it will give
my daughter even a little extra boost.

And it was likely an expression of their warm desire
for their daughter to wear a racing outfit that truly suited her.
Once the invited guests had left, I decided to speak to Daiichi Ruby.
choice_data_list: This racewear is truly filled with your parents' love.
Your racing outfit is filled with your parents' love, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to this racing attire,
I am constantly mindful of my family's mission.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
To be magnificent, to be supreme...
—it serves as a strong reminder.

She said it as if convincing herself.
Of course, that's likely part of it—
but I feel there's more to it than just a harsh declaration.
choice_data_list: I think that's also out of kindness to you.
I think there's kindness toward you in that, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Regardless, I will merely fulfill my duty.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it seems you like it too
I'm glad it seems you like it too.
I think it really suits you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Regardless, I will merely fulfill my duty.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it seems you like it too
I'm glad it seems you like it too.
I think it really suits you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It constantly inspires me to be someone
worthy of wearing this outfit.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: In that sense, I believe it would be optimal.
choice_data_list: (I guess that means she likes it.)

text_block_list.text:
"Just as her parents had hoped,
this racing attire will surely give Daiichi Ruby
the extra push she needs."

"Just as her parents said,
it looks great on her with her reddish eyes."

I told them that you had observed them closely
and given it a great deal of thought.

"I told them that you had observed them closely
and truly put a great deal of thought into it."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Because you know me better than anyone else.
Her voice was calm, just as usual, but unmistakable respect for her parents could be felt in her words.
